cards.text: Identify pet-related signals in comments and combine their share with channel size to shortlist channels for review before an advertising pilot.

cards.title: Bank churn: patterns, explanations and service capacity
cards.text: Identify churn signals and compare service capacity with follow-up costs to prioritize customers for proactive contact and further review.

cards.title: First-order fraud: temporal evaluation and review proposals
cards.text: Time-based validation found no test-set fraud at the selected decision threshold. Device, IP and transaction-timing signals inform a tiered manual-review proposal.

cards.title: LendingClub: the 9,004-loan sample
cards.text: Compare loan models with a simple loan-term rule under the costs of missed defaults and false alerts to inform review lists and screening thresholds.

cards.title: A/B Testing: the Cookie Cats gate experiment
cards.text: Seven-day retention was 0.82 percentage points lower in the level-40 group than in the level-30 group. Allocation checks qualify recommendations on gate placement and the return experience.

cards.title: Healthy Home: spatial prediction and road mapping in Oakland
cards.text: Evaluate pollutant predictions on held-out areas, then use relative road maps and area-level errors to identify where more observations are needed.

cards.title: Amazon watch reviews: clustering, topics and recommendations
cards.text: Malfunctions and returns stand out in low-rated reviews. Clustering and topic analysis turn that feedback into recommendations for product checks, clearer instructions and review monitoring.
